claims.claim: Gen Digital Q1 FY27 raised full-year guidance to $5.375B-$5.475B revenue and $2.87-$2.97 non-GAAP EPS after FY26 revenue crossed $5B; the platform now combines cyber safety, identity protection and financial wellness following the MoneyLion acquisition.

risks.risk: MoneyLion broadens Gen beyond cyber safety, creating integration and cross-sell execution risk; headline growth includes acquisition effects and should not be treated as purely organic.

unknowns.unknown: This evidence does not isolate organic contribution or long-run unit economics of the financial-wellness expansion.

claims.claim: The beat-and-raise Q1 signal supports execution momentum, but the thesis should be tested on organic retention/cross-sell and integration quality rather than consolidated growth alone.

risks.risk: Acquisition-assisted growth can obscure underlying product-level retention and monetization trends.

unknowns.unknown: Product-level cohort retention and MoneyLion synergy realization were not established in this Scout pass.
